changes.title: Chart stay
items: On the sea chart, the island you're on now says "Back to the party" (or "Back to the afterparty" once the party's over): choosing it closes the chart and you're back where you were, with no sailing and no new night. Going to bed is still how to start the same island again

changes.title: Spooky grade slider
items: Pause page, Leaf jitter: a Spooky colour grade slider (0 to 1, 0.9 as before) for how strongly the night drains and blue-tints the darker colours, so you can see the autumn leaves' own oranges and reds

changes.title: Station panels
items: In the treehouse, walking up to the mirror, the wardrobe, the cloak pegs, the shoe rack, the bags or the broom stand slides its choices in from the left over the game, and walking away slides them out: no more trip back to the bedroom screen
Changes there show on her straight away as she stands there
